name: SVGOMG
tagline: Make SVG pictures smaller, on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Drop an SVG and it comes back smaller. Turn clean-up steps on and off, watch the picture and the file size change, then download. Paste the markup if you would rather not pick a file. A sample picture is included so you can try it straight away.

An unofficial port of SVGOMG by jakearchibald. The original is a website; this copy keeps the same clean-up steps, with tracking stripped and no path out to a server. The picture you drop in never leaves this device. There is no account, no queue and no upload.

What you choose — which clean-up steps, how many decimal places — stays in the app so the next picture starts where you left off.

Nothing is fetched, and nothing you drop in is sent anywhere.
